about_the_game:
People called it PEAK.

We call it just the beginning.

What if your jetpack wasn’t just a tool—what if it was your only way out?
Operation Sour Power is a rebellious, fast-flowing platformer where you charge, blast, and bounce through a collapsing machine-run world.
Built for expression. Fueled by momentum. Designed with a speedrunner’s heart and a dreamer’s soul.

Core Features

  • Precision platforming with tight, expressive movement

  • A jetpack system that’s instantly fun—and endlessly satisfying

  • Environmental combat using trampolines, magnets, and gravity

  • Hand-drawn art and a playful tone with serious heart

It's just you, your jetpack, your instincts, and gravity begging you to fall.

Platform Your Way

No rails. No forced paths. Just your instincts and a jetpack.
Bounce, fly, and dodge your way upward in a world where every room is a puzzle—and a playground.

The Jetpack Is the Point

Built around the jetpack, not just with it.
Boost through tight spaces, combo through checkpoints, and feel the rhythm of flow-state traversal.

Environmental Combat


You don’t fight with fists—you fight with momentum.
Use magnets, trampolines, and raw velocity to launch yourself into enemies and bust through the system—literally.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS *: Windows 7 SP1+
  • Processor: Dual-core processor (2.0 GHz)
  • Memory: 2048 MB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel HD Graphics 4000 or equivalent
  • DirectX: Version 10
  • Storage: 100 MB MB available space
  • Sound Card: Any
  • Additional Notes: Optimized for low-spec systems; runs well on most hardware from the last 10 years.
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Quad-core processor (2.5 GHz+)
  • Memory: 4096 MB RAM
  • Graphics: Dedicated GPU (GTX 750 / Radeon R7 or better)
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 150 MB available space
  • Sound Card: Any
  • Additional Notes: For smoothest visuals during intense platforming sequences.
